MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.

4. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Production Systems? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Production Systems.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Production Systems.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Production Systems.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Production Systems.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Morphology and Anatomy? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Morphology and Anatomy.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Aquaculture.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Pond? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Pond.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Pond.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Pond.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Pond.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

13. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Safety and Survival Techniques / and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Morphology and Anatomy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
